statement: ∀ {X : Type} [PseudoEMetricSpace X] (s δ : ℝ) (B : Set X) (U : ℕ → Set X) (hU : B ⊆ ⋃ i, U i) (hδ : ∀ i, Metric.ediam (U i) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal δ), GDContent s δ B ≤ ∑' i, GDCost s (U i)
proof:
intro X _ s δ B U hU hδ
unfold GDContent
exact iInf_le_of_le U (iInf_le_of_le hU (iInf_le_of_le hδ le_rfl))
